verdict.rationale: Docs show Copilot can launch and track multiple agent sessions in parallel (docs-8, docs-14) and run cloud agents automatically via automations on schedule/events across a repo (docs-15), which supports some bulk/automated workflows across many tasks. However there's no explicit documentation of a bulk operation feature (e.g., applying one edit across many files/items in a single command) distinct from per-agent task assignment. missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/bulk-apply tooling across many items in one action, independent hands-on evidence of scaling to large numbers of items, and details on limits/performance at scale.
